patch.value: The pinned SDK listMutationEvents requires pmRoot/cwd and authoritative resume history uses getHistoryPath plus readHistoryEntries. Native scoped event/history capability ports remain upstream #1587; reusable adapter conformance remains #1588. No alternative event authority or global snapshot promise is introduced in the delivered slice.
Use durable scoped native backend history and resume cursors
Remaining realtime and historical read slice of roadmap #260; preserve explicit resync receipts and missed-event recovery.

Move mutation subscriptions, point-in-time history and resume reads to backend-bound upstream capabilities; keep filesystem sweeps inside the directory adapter only; durable cursors survive process restart and retention changes with explicit gap or resync receipts; recheck revocation across pages and response boundaries; prove concurrent backdated appends, missed events, tenant isolation, replay and restart against filesystem and a native provider without local tracker; disclose cross-source consistency limits and optional Git capabilities.
